title: Full Stack Engineer
description: About Ironstone Ironstone is an AI product startup in Maslak, İstanbul. We build consumer apps for learning, wellbeing and everyday utility, and we're now building our main project: a new SaaS platform for businesses. We're hiring our first team, so the people who join now shape what we build and how we build it. What we’re building We’re building an AI-first platform that helps businesses turn what they already have into finished, high-quality work in minutes instead of weeks. Under the hood it runs on a pipeline of AI models, automated quality checks and media processing. The interesting problems are in that pipeline: orchestrating models at scale, judging AI output automatically, and making the results reliable enough for businesses to use as-is. We don’t talk about the specifics publicly yet; we will on the intro call. About the role You’ll be engineer number one and our technical lead, working directly with the founder. This is a hands-on role: you’ll write code and ship features every day, building the architecture, data model, web app, AI pipelines and AWS infrastructure yourself. Alongside the building, you’ll play a leading role in architecture and tool planning, including which vendors and services we use, set the engineering standards the team builds on, and manage the technical side of the project day to day. What you’ll do Build the web app with Next.js (App Router), React and TypeScript, using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. Design the data model and APIs on Supabase (Postgres, Auth, row-level security, Realtime) with Drizzle. Build durable background workflows on AWS (Step Functions, Lambda, SQS) that orchestrate AI models, with retries, queues and webhooks done properly. Integrate language, image and video models behind a clean provider layer, so we can switch models without touching the product. Build automated quality gates that score generated images and video before users see them. Build video and image finishing (rendering, captions, resizing) and delivery through S3 and CloudFront. Implement usage-based billing on an auditable, append-only credit ledger. Set up CI/CD, preview environments, infrastructure as code (AWS CDK), monitoring (Sentry) and product analytics (PostHog). Plan the architecture and tooling together with the founder, and document the decisions so the team can move fast. Manage the project’s technical work: plan the sprints, set priorities, review code and keep delivery on track. What we look for 3+ years building production web applications, including owning the architecture of at least one production system built on background jobs or workflows. Strong TypeScript, React and Next.js. Solid Postgres and API design: schemas, migrations, auth and access control. Solid knowledge of, and hands-on experience with, AWS, Google Cloud or another major cloud platform. Comfortable debugging distributed systems: a stuck workflow, a failed webhook, a queue that backs up. You’ve shipped AI features to real users and know where they break. You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) daily and can show how they make you faster without making your code worse. You’ve led technical projects, reviewed other people’s code or mentored engineers as part of your job. Good written and spoken English. Nice to have Supabase, AWS Step Functions or other workflow engines. Programmatic video and image processing (FFmpeg, Remotion, HyperFrames or similar). Generative image or video models in production, or computer-vision checks on generated media. LLM evaluation and prompt engineering. MCP servers, OAuth 2.1 or building integrations with AI assistants. Payments and subscriptions (Paddle, Stripe). What we offer A new MacBook Claude subscription Meal card Revenue-linked bonus Real ownership

title: Senior Computer Vision & Backend Engineer (Python) – Remote
description: Turn a phone camera into a physiotherapist. Breathment is a Munich-based digital health startup. We digitize pulmonary rehabilitation for people living with chronic respiratory diseases such as COPD: our app guides patients through therapy exercises at home, watches their movement through the phone camera and gives feedback in real time, while physiotherapists and physicians follow their progress remotely through our telemonitoring platform. We work with German clinics, physiotherapists and health insurers, and every release reaches real patients. We are looking for a senior engineer who is at home in both worlds: computer vision and production backend. You will own the path from neural-network output to what the patient sees on screen and what the therapist reads in the report. What you will build Own the computer-vision pipeline that turns pose-estimation output from our neural networks into repetition counts, posture feedback and set-by-set exercise analysis. Design the reporting layer that converts raw movement data into clinical reports physiotherapists act on. Build and extend our Python backend (FastAPI, MongoDB, Redis): the API behind the patient app and the clinician platform. Ship to production on Kubernetes with GPU inference services, and stand behind what you ship: tests, monitoring and clean handovers. Analyse requirements together with product, physiotherapists and the mobile team, and propose solutions instead of waiting for tickets. What you bring 5+ years of professional software development in Python, including at least a year running a FastAPI (or comparable async) service in production. Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow). You have built real product features on top of model output, not only trained models in notebooks. Solid experience with NoSQL databases, ideally MongoDB, and with data models that survive growth. A university degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mathematics, physics or a related field from one of the universities listed under "Education" below. A fluent Git and GitHub workflow: branches, reviews, CI. Strong analytical thinking and an independent, structured way of working. You can take an ambiguous problem and drive it to a shipped result in a remote team. Professional working proficiency in English. German is a plus, not a requirement. Genuine interest in startups: you want responsibility, and you want to see the effect of your work on patients. Nice to have Pose estimation, human motion analysis or video processing (OpenCV, MediaPipe or similar). Docker, Kubernetes and cloud deployments; workflow engines such as Temporal. Daily use of AI coding tools with a clear habit of verifying what they produce. Software in a regulated environment: medical devices, health data, GDPR. Why Breathment Impact you can see: your code helps patients rehabilitate at home instead of waiting months for a clinic place. Remote-first: work from anywhere. A small senior team with short decision paths and direct access to founders, medical team and users. A modern stack: Python 3, FastAPI, MongoDB, Redis, PyTorch, Kubernetes, GPU inference. Education For this opening we are recruiting graduates of the universities that the Turkish Council of Higher Education (YÖK) designates as Research Universities (Araştırma Üniversiteleri), full members as published on YÖK's website at the time of application. Among them: Istanbul Technical University, Middle East Technical University, Boğaziçi University, Koç University, Bilkent University, Sabancı University, Hacettepe University, Yildiz Technical University, Istanbul University, Ankara University, Ege University, Gebze Technical University and İzmir Institute of Technology. If your degree is from elsewhere, this particular role is not a match, and we would rather tell you now than after you have spent time applying. How we hire Apply on LinkedIn with your CV and answer the short screening questions. Please read them carefully; they decide whether we see your application. If you pass, we send you six written questions by LinkedIn message (about 20 minutes, no cover letter). We read every answer ourselves and prefer specific over polished. 30-minute intro call Technical interview including a coding challenge Founder conversation and offer We aim to complete the whole process within one month.

description: Avenga is an international engineering firm helping businesses operate with AI at the core. With 6,000+ experts worldwide, we combine engineering expertise with AI-native thinking to turn ambitious ideas into real-world impact across industries, technologies, and markets. Core skills you’ll bring 5+ years of backend development experience with strong C#/.NET and ASP.NET Core skills (Java also acceptable). Experience designing scalable APIs, microservices, and distributed, event-driven systems. Hands-on experience with FIX protocol in capital markets or electronic trading. Experience implementing authentication and authorization using OAuth2, OpenID Connect, or IdentityServer. Experience developing financial calculations, pricing engines, or quantitative models using QuantLib or similar libraries . Strong knowledge of MongoDB and messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ or MassTransit. Familiarity with observability tools such as Elasticsearch, Datadog, or Sentry. Understanding of numerical precision and financial market conventions. Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Nice-to-have Knowledge of fixed-income instruments and securities pricing. Experience with Pulsar, Databricks, or Lakehouse architectures. Familiarity with Redis, event sourcing, SignalR, or WebSockets. Exposure to React, Redux, or Rematch. Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to architectural decisions. The impact you'll create Design and develop scalable backend services and APIs using C#/.NET. Build and maintain FIX integrations for electronic trading workflows. Develop financial calculation engines, pricing models, and quantitative algorithms. Implement secure authentication, authorization, and identity solutions. Build event-driven microservices using distributed messaging technologies. Optimize data processing and storage using MongoDB, Redis, and Elasticsearch. Improve system reliability through monitoring, telemetry, and automated testing. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, contribute to architecture, and mentor engineers. People are at the core of Avenga. We provide equal opportunities regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion, or any other characteristic. We are committed to a respectful environment where everyone can be themselves, share their ideas, and feel that they belong.
